notes.title: DON'T! FRET END OF YEAR UPDATE!
notes.notes:
2024 WAS AN AMAZING YEAR
We kicked off the year back in March with the announcement trailer for Don't! Fret, which in the first month received over 200K views. The hype was very real, and it was amazing to begin to put Don't! Fret on the map. In case you didn't know, Scary Kid Studios has a YouTube channel where put Devlogs, Trailers and more!

[previewyoutube=BwslxiWXHUM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

DEMO RELEASE
On October 18th, we released the demo for Don't! Fret: The Audition. For those of you who follow our other socials you will know, that this demo actually was intended to be an entire Chapter 1 (when we had it as an episodic format!). After much debate, we decided to turn Don't! Fret into a full length came, and we are aiming for a 4-7 hour game experience! 

The demo was received incredibly well, and we currently have 97 reviews with a VERY POSITIVE rating! We also had so many incredible influencers play the demo, including our very own Game Theory! 

[previewyoutube=y6hX0qViqLs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

WHAT'S NEXT?
We have been VERY quiet since the release of the Don't! Fret demo and the reason is a good one... WE ARE VERY HARD AT WORK ON THE FULLY GAME ːsteamhappyː

As game developers, this is our first game and so there are so many things and processes we are learning as we go. It took us over a year just to get the demo into a solid, playable state with art assets, mechanics, sound design etc. Since the demo, we have hired on a new full time developer, and additional help with animations and 3D modeling. The game is turning into a beast we could have never imaged possible (in a good way)!

We have overhauled many of the mechanics that were in the demo. Doors, portals, equipment, enemies and so much more. The demo was only scratching the surface of the story we are diving into in the full game!

WHEN IS THE RELEASE?
In an effort to be transparent, as we always try and do - we don't have an official release date for the game however, we are aiming for Q3 or Q4 of 2025. So far, we have been doing a great job sticking to our schedules and milestone reviews. 

As the game grows, and we begin to fully test - I'm sure we can expect some roadblocks, but rest assured - we are planning for them!

Thank you to everyone who has continued to support us along this crazy journey. Looking forward to seeing you in the new year! We're cooking up some amazing things and we can't wait to show you!

notes.title: PATCH 1.1 - Performance Optimization & Xbox Controller Support
notes.notes:
CPU & GPU Performance Optimization
50% frame increase
Significantly reduced draw calls
Reduced total triangles visible on screen
LOD optimization
Batched static mesh throughout the map
GPU optimization with particle effects

Xbox Controller Support
Xbox controller support
NOTE: There are known issues with keypad losing movement with controller. If this happens, you can use your mouse and keyboard to progress
NOTE: PS5 and Steam Deck support is not fully compatible yet but is on the horizon

Added additional frame limits
Increased frame limit cap to 144

Bug Fixes
Player can no longer interact with light switch from inside of Waste Room
Pressing wrong number on payphone no longer results in an infinite dial
Player can no longer move during cut scenes after first playthrough
Fixed issue where player can press reload on flashlight and begin to use it before animation is completed
Fixed issue where interacting with machine or cassette player would allow you to use an item without being near it

Known Issues
Xbox controller input issues where controller loses input for certain objects like keypad, payphone
No PS4 or PS5 controller support
No Steam Deck Support

notes.title: DON'T! FRET: THE AUDITION RELEASE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910425/398bef1007567925c193af0203e7014146f2e4d9.png

DON'T! FRET IS FINALLY HERE
We are so excited to announce the release date of the demo of Don't! Fret. We have been working so hard on this experience, and we can't wait to share it with the world! A few things to note as we prepare for the demo!

CONTENT CREATOR FIRST LOOK KEYS
If you are a content creator, and would like a key to play Don't! Fret early, please use this Google Form to be considered. We will be sending personalized keys out on Monday 10/14/24. NOTE: We won't be able to send keys to everyone, so if you aren't chosen - it doesn't mean we don't love you!

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE DEMO?
We had many conversations internally of how we wanted to present the demo to the world. Don't! Fret was originally going to be an episodic game, with chapters releasing periodically as we completed the game.Instead we have decided to create a full length game, which means - we wanted community feedback. That's where the demo comes in!

Don't! Fret: The Audition is a full experience, and will tie into the main game. Consider it a prologue, and a standalone product. 

WE NEED YOUR HELP
I've been a content creator and music producer with Rockit Music for over 10 years... but developing a game is something I have NEVER done! 

Our team is comprised of 13 individuals, and we all work remotely, and this is ALL of our first game. It has become an incredibly huge undertaking that none of us fully expected, nor set out to do in the first place.
I genuinely ask the community, and everyone who plays to leave feedback for us to help us improve mechanics or issues that arise, to ensure we create the best possible product for the full game release.

Thank you all from the bottom of our hearts. We hope you enjoy the game.

- Scary Kid Studios
